name: Rafid Intelligence Network
description: Rafid Agent API provides structured intelligence and paid APIs for AI agents across property, company and risk, supplier, finance, document, website, automotive, logistics, recruitment, trading, voice, video and business-planning workflows.

skills.name: analyze_property
skills.description: Calculate gross/net rental yield, income, operating costs and simple payback in OMR. Calculations only.

skills.name: compare_properties
skills.description: Compare 2–20 uniquely named properties in OMR using the same metrics; order by rounded net yield, preserving input order for ties.

skills.name: estimate_maintenance
skills.description: Estimate an annual maintenance reserve in OMR from value, age and unit count with explicit optional assumptions. Uncalibrated heuristic, not a survey.

skills.name: analyze_oman_property
skills.description: Analyze an Oman residential property using local rental comparables, market context and investment metrics, including partner-supplied historical and recent Al Mouj Muscat property sales records with provenance and freshness metadata when coverage is available.

skills.name: search_oman_company
skills.description: Search structured Oman business records by name, registration number, governorate, wilayat and/or industry, returning candidate companies ranked by deterministic identity-match confidence.

skills.name: get_oman_company_profile
skills.description: Return a structured profile for one Oman company by companyId — identity, registration, location and contact fields, digital-presence detection and full source provenance.

skills.name: analyze_oman_company
skills.description: Generate deterministic commercial-intelligence signals, risk flags and positive signals for one Oman company by companyId, for a stated evaluation purpose.

skills.name: due_diligence_oman_company
skills.description: Perform structured commercial due diligence on one Oman company by companyId ahead of a stated transaction, returning identity verification, risk assessment, a prioritized due-diligence checklist and known information gaps.

skills.name: research_company
skills.description: Research a company from public web sources: overview, products, leadership, funding, competitors, technology signals, recent developments and risk flags, with cited sources and a confidence score.

skills.name: find_companies
skills.description: Discover companies from public web sources matching an industry, location, size and/or keyword criteria, returning cited candidate companies (never fabricated) with a stated confidence score.

skills.name: analyze_company_risk
skills.description: Gather evidence-tiered risk signals for a company across corporate identity, domain, website, sanctions-list name-matching, adverse news, reputation and legal/regulatory signals — never a safe/unsafe verdict.

skills.name: oman_supplier_check
skills.description: Screen an Oman supplier for procurement using company identity, business activity, website, contact consistency, address signals, public-risk indicators and sanctions screening.

skills.name: company_reputation_check
skills.description: Investigate the public reputation and commercial risk signals of a company in any country — identity consistency against official registries, sanctions-list name screening, adverse media (with legal stage: allegation vs. outcome), customer reputation, online presence, business stability and domain signals — returning evidence-linked scores with a separate confidence score.

skills.name: business_risk_score
skills.description: Assess the risk of doing business with a company in any country using corporate, financial, compliance, reputation, operational and digital evidence. Returns a 0–100 risk score (100 = highest detected risk), a separate 0–1 confidence, per-category component scores, evidence-backed risk flags and positive signals, sanctions/restricted-party screening with match strength, and machine-readable due-diligence guidance (proceed / proceed_with_monitoring / enhanced_due_diligence / manual_review / avoid_automated_transaction).

skills.name: social_video_generate
skills.description: Generate a complete short-form social video from a topic or supplied script, including narration, visual materials, subtitles and final video composition.

skills.name: news_video_generate
skills.description: Turn supplied factual news content into a publish-ready short-form news video without independently researching or fabricating current events.

skills.name: product_promo_video
skills.description: Generate a promotional short video from structured product information, features, call to action and optional website.

skills.name: company_due_diligence
skills.description: Perform company due diligence for onboarding, procurement, partnership, investment or customer-risk decisions: resolve the entity, evaluate registration, website identity, sanctions, adverse news, legal, financial and reputation signals, then return a deterministic risk assessment with evidence and a machine-actionable next action.

skills.name: document_facts_extract
skills.description: Extract structured, evidence-backed facts, entities, dates, amounts, obligations, deadlines and risk indicators from business documents (contracts, invoices, purchase orders, quotations, tenders/RFPs, leases, policies, financial reports, legal documents, CVs, company profiles) from any country. Every fact carries a 0–1 extraction confidence and source evidence (verbatim excerpt, character offsets, section, and the page when the document has real pages); dates, amounts, currencies, percentages and durations are normalized only when unambiguous. Accepts an https documentUrl (PDF with a text layer, DOCX, HTML, text) or extracted text, up to 25 pages.

skills.name: invoice_anomaly_check
skills.description: Detect duplicate, inconsistent, unusual or potentially fraudulent invoices before payment using arithmetic, supplier-history, purchase-order and payment-detail checks. Returns a 0–100 risk score, a risk level, an advisory decision (continue / review / hold) and machine-readable anomalies (e.g. DUPLICATE_INVOICE, POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE, BANK_ACCOUNT_CHANGED, PO_AMOUNT_EXCEEDED, SPLIT_INVOICE_PATTERN, SUBTOTAL_MISMATCH), each with severity, confidence and structured evidence. Works on a single invoice (standalone) or with optional historical invoices, supplier profile, purchase order, contract, approval threshold and payment history (context-aware). Deterministic, decimal-safe, any country and currency.

skills.name: vehicle_value_estimate
skills.description: Estimate the fair market value of a vehicle using make, model, year, trim, mileage, condition, ownership history, location and available market comparables. Returns a valuation range, private-sale estimate, dealer buy/retail estimates, depreciation, transparent valuation adjustments, confidence and risk flags.

skills.name: website_download
skills.description: Download and mirror a publicly accessible website, including HTML pages and required frontend assets, and return a machine-readable manifest and optional downloadable archive.

skills.name: extract_candidate_profile
skills.description: Normalize an English, Arabic or mixed-language CV into a machine-readable candidate profile using only stated professional evidence; protected personal attributes are ignored.

skills.name: generate_job_profile
skills.description: Normalize a job description into required and preferred professional requirements with transparent weights totaling 100.

skills.name: cv_score
skills.description: Score the completeness, clarity and ATS-readability of a CV on a transparent 0–100 scale; this is not job matching.

skills.name: cv_job_match
skills.description: Compare a candidate profile or CV with a job profile or description using normalized skills, experience evidence and transparent weighted scoring.

skills.name: cv_improve
skills.description: Produce evidence-grounded CV improvement recommendations, optional job-specific guidance and ATS actions without inventing candidate facts.

skills.name: candidate_shortlist_score
skills.description: Score up to 100 supplied candidate profiles against one job profile with auditable matched requirements, gaps and confidence; no hiring decision is emitted.

skills.name: strategy_performance_analysis
skills.description: Calculate historical trade-level strategy performance metrics from supplied records, including P&L, win/loss statistics and supported drawdown metrics; this is historical analysis, not a forecast.

skills.name: trade_risk_score
skills.description: Calculate a transparent deterministic 0–100 risk score for a proposed trade from entry, protection, sizing, account and portfolio context.

skills.name: portfolio_exposure_check
skills.description: Aggregate supplied open and proposed positions into gross, net, directional and concentration exposure with stop-risk and margin indicators.

skills.name: trade_log_analysis
skills.description: Analyze supplied raw trade records for deterministic performance, execution quality, grouping, streaks, data-quality issues and risk patterns.

skills.name: shipping_cost_estimate
skills.description: Estimate domestic or international shipping cost, chargeable weight, transit time and common shipping surcharges using shipment dimensions, weight, origin, destination and service level. Estimates are not guaranteed carrier quotes; duties and taxes are excluded.

skills.name: ai_call_agent
skills.description: Initiate an authorized outbound AI telephone call and return a call identifier immediately; completion and duration arrive asynchronously.

skills.name: voice_lead_qualifier
skills.description: Place an asynchronous sales qualification call and score captured evidence against a configurable rubric.

skills.name: website_project_estimate
skills.description: Produce a deterministic website project estimate with cost, timeline, hours, effort breakdown, maintenance range, assumptions and risk flags. It is an estimate, not a fixed quotation.

skills.name: website_audit
skills.description: Perform a bounded, passive technical website inspection covering measurable SEO, performance, accessibility, security, UX and crawlability indicators; unavailable checks are reported honestly.

skills.name: appointment_call_agent
skills.description: Place an asynchronous appointment call to propose, book, confirm, reschedule or cancel a slot through a calendar-provider abstraction.

skills.name: supplier_due_diligence_report
skills.description: Run an end-to-end Oman supplier screening workflow covering identity, activity, website, contact consistency, address, sanctions and public-risk evidence in one structured report.

skills.name: company_risk_report
skills.description: Combine evidence-first public reputation analysis with structured business-risk scoring into one company risk report.

skills.name: property_investment_report
skills.description: Combine Oman property market comparables, price positioning and rental-yield calculations into one investment report.

skills.name: portfolio_screen
skills.description: Screen and rank a portfolio of 2–20 supplied properties using the shared rental-yield and income calculations.

skills.name: procurement_vendor_shortlist
skills.description: Screen and rank 2–50 Oman suppliers in one procurement workflow using identity, risk, sanctions and public-evidence signals.

skills.name: company_risk_batch
skills.description: Assess 1–100 companies from structured rows or CSV in one bounded batch, preserving per-row risk results and provider failures.

skills.name: startup_readiness_score
skills.description: Score the book's 15-question readiness assessment deterministically; does not predict business success.

skills.name: business_idea_validate
skills.description: Evaluate problem, customer, solution and willingness-to-pay evidence; does not independently verify live demand.

skills.name: business_idea_generator
skills.description: Generate candidate ideas from user-observed problems and constraints; does not claim market demand.

skills.name: business_validation_plan
skills.description: Create the book's structured seven-day validation workflow; execution and evidence collection remain with the caller.

skills.name: ideal_customer_profile
skills.description: Structure an ideal-customer profile from supplied observations; does not infer verified demographics.

skills.name: competitor_analysis
skills.description: Compare 3-20 user-supplied competitors; does not discover or verify competitors without live evidence.

skills.name: business_model_builder
skills.description: Build the book's ten-element one-page business map from supplied inputs.

skills.name: startup_cost_estimate
skills.description: Calculate startup capital, runway and reserve in OMR using integer baisa internally.

skills.name: product_pricing_calculator
skills.description: Calculate unit cost, price, margin and markup in OMR; does not validate market willingness to pay.

skills.name: break_even_calculator
skills.description: Calculate break-even and target-profit units from supplied fixed and variable costs.

skills.name: business_profitability_analysis
skills.description: Calculate revenue, gross profit, net profit and margins from monthly supplied data.

skills.name: offer_builder
skills.description: Construct a commercial offer from supplied outcome, bundle and delivery terms; never invents scarcity.

skills.name: oman_go_to_market_plan
skills.description: Select supplied Oman-relevant channels for an ICP and create a 14-day action plan; live popularity is not checked.

skills.name: content_plan_generator
skills.description: Generate a 14- or 30-day structured content calendar from an offer and selected channels.

skills.name: first_10_customers_plan
skills.description: Create a non-spammy plan for 20 prospects and the first 10 paying customers.

skills.name: sales_response_builder
skills.description: Draft a customer-facing response for a supplied sales situation; does not send messages.

skills.name: whatsapp_business_setup
skills.description: Create Arabic/English WhatsApp Business profile, reply and order-message templates.

skills.name: monthly_business_financial_report
skills.description: Generate a monthly business financial report from supplied OMR figures; not accounting advice.

skills.name: oman_business_launch_plan
skills.description: Generate the book's 30-day launch workflow with dependencies and status placeholders.

skills.name: business_90_day_growth_plan
skills.description: Generate the book's three-month post-launch goals, milestones, KPIs and review gates.

skills.name: business_risk_check
skills.description: Diagnose the book's common mistakes from supplied signals; no unsupported probabilities are assigned.

skills.name: final_business_plan_builder
skills.description: Assemble the book's final project plan from supplied business and financial inputs.

skills.name: oman_business_launch_advisor
skills.description: Combine readiness, idea validation, finance and launch logic for an Oman-oriented founder workflow.

skills.name: oman_business_plan_generator
skills.description: Generate a premium structured business plan from supplied assumptions; not legal, tax, accounting or investment advice.

skills.name: oman_small_business_guide
skills.description: Answer a question using book-grounded frameworks; current legal, tax and regulatory details require official verification.
